{{Discuss|channel=contributing}}

The papers of the reference catalogue, one line each, grouped by topic. This page is generated by a script from the catalogue; a new paper usually arrives with the proposal that cites it, and an entry is corrected by a proposal on the talk page of this page (see [[How to contribute#The TeX format|How to contribute]]); the catalogue is updated first. Pages cite these entries by their key, for instance [[Literature#BedrossianCotiZelati2017|Bedrossian and Coti Zelati (2017)]]. Preprints are listed with their arXiv identifier. The list is a working bibliography, not a survey of the field.
